scope: 711 printed cards checked for Equip icon; all3 original Equip Spells reviewed for extra activation controller restrictions. Equip-as-monster effects are outside this card-activation family. Source/printed limit comparison plus12 scoped native cases,not full-card certification.
rule_application: Equip Spells may equip own or opponent monsters depending on printed limits. Neither repaired card specifies own controller.

cards.name: Kanmuriyama
cards.text: Equip only to a Spirit monster. If this card becomes equipped to a monster: You can add 1 Spirit monster from your Deck to your hand with a different Attribute than the equipped monster. You can only use the previous effect of "Kanmuriyama" once per turn. If this card is destroyed and sent from the field to the GY because the equipped monster returned to the hand: You can add this card to the hand. At the start of the Damage Step, if the equipped monster battles an opponent's monster, you can return that monster to the hand.
cards.review: Already selects either field;unchanged and native-tested.

cards.name: Phantasm Spiral Resurgence
cards.text: Equip only to a non-Effect monster. If the equipped monster battles your opponent's monster: Halve that monster's ATK and DEF, also, negate its effect until the end of this turn (including in the GY). When the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can add 1 "Phantasm Spiral" card from your GY to your hand.
cards.review: Confirmed unprinted own-controller restriction;repair activation precheck,selection and chkc location validation.

cards.name: Teleum Mortis
cards.text: Equip only to a "Vir Pedicae Mortis" monster. A monster equiped with this card gains 500 ATK for each "Bear Trap" activated this Duel. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.
cards.review: Confirmed unprinted own-controller restriction;repair activation precheck,selection and chkc location validation.
